english.title: Holder of article 180 approval permit person to act as air traffic controller without licence / when not competent
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the holder of an approval granted under article 180 of the Air Navigation Order 2016, permitted **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) to act as

(A)_[an air traffic controller]_
(B)_[a student air traffic controller]_

in the provision of the service under the approval when

(C)_[that person did not hold an appropriate licence]_
(D)_[you were not satisfied that he was competent to perform the duties of such a controller]_
(E)_[you were not satisfied that she was competent to perform the duties of such a controller]_
english.legislation: Contrary to articles 181 and 265(6) of the Air Navigation Order 2016.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
being the holder of an approval granted under article 180 of the Order
permitted a person to act as an air traffic controller or student air traffic controller
in the provision of the service under the approval when
that person did not hold an appropriate licence OR
you were not satisfied that he or she was competent to perform the duties of such a controller
